name: TeamPalettes
note: 28 rows of 16 colours in team order (ANH..WSH, then the two all-star teams), packed format 2 ($0380 bytes); $C4D77F and $C590F0 unpack it to $7F:D80A; $C5A4B9 / $C5A4E2 queue row (team $17C9 / $17CB) to CGRAM palettes 2 / 3

name: ArrowFontTiles
note: 96 4bpp tiles, packed format 4: a two colour font for ASCII $20-$7F with arrows at ^ _ ~ and $7F; $C5521E loads it to VRAM $4A00 through $C58A65; the screen that uses it is not traced yet

name: GradientBarTiles
note: 18 4bpp tiles, packed format 2: bars shaded dark to light; unpacked at $C401B7 / $C4D864 / $C559CC / $C59119 and queued for VRAM

name: MeterFontTiles
note: 128 4bpp tiles, packed format 6: meter bars in three colours, a PwrPlay label, box corners, then ASCII $20-$7F; $C521EB and $C55826 load it to VRAM $4800 through $C58A65

name: UnusedPalette
note: 16 colours after MeterFontTiles; no 16-bit operand or pointer in the ROM is $0EE5

name: SoundRAMClear
note: SPC700 program at sound RAM $0020 as IPL upload blocks; $CF001A sends it through $CF004B, then the sound driver stream at $C00F49

name: .loop
note: SoundRAMClear: page clear loop (sound RAM $0038; the store's high byte is the page)

name: .end
note: SoundRAMClear: end block (length 0 and the start address)

name: SPC_IPLROM
note: sound CPU boot ROM entry (SoundRAMClear pcall target)
